lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: My name is Cervan Cornell.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I come from what you'd consider an entitled upbringing.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I'm the son of a high-ranking military official.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: You may have heard my name on the news.
Can't say that I have.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Well, that's okay. Haha.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: What's important is that you and I are birds of a feather.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: It's been 10 years since I was first commissioned as a Commander,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: but I remember my first assignment like it was yesterday.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I took two Nikke platoons out,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: and we were able to take down a big one.
I assume you're referring to...

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Yes, a Rapture.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Anyways, the military gave me a medal for it.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: But I ended up misplacing it somewhere along the way.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Such stupidity on my part... It's embarrassing to recall.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Anyway, I suppose I should get to the point.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Do you have any intention of selling your medals to me?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: A Commander as reputable as you

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: must be swimming in them. I'm sure you wouldn't mind parting with a few.
I don't have any medals.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: What?
However, I might be able to help you find the medal that you lost.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Hmmm...

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: You don't have to do that...
Do you have a general idea where you lost it?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: It was so long ago,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: it's hard to remember.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I need to think a bit further back.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: If I come up with anything, I'll be in touch.
That was the last I heard of him for a while.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Excuse me.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Kept you waiting, huh?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: These are the coordinates.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: If you go there, I'm positive you'll find my medal.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: If you manage to find it,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I'll be forever grateful.
